android.desc:
Built by traders, for traders. In fast-moving financial markets, speed and reliability make the difference. Download Forex News & Economic Calendar today and trade with clarity.

Whether you are a day trader, swing trader, or investor, Forex News & Economic Calendar is your all-in-one companion to elevate your trading execution. Eliminate the need to switch between multiple websites. Access live economic data, breaking headlines, real-time price alerts, currency strength metrics, and risk management tools in a single mobile workspace.

KEY FEATURES

Real-Time Economic Calendar
Never get caught off guard by volatility. Track global financial releases, central bank decisions, and geopolitical announcements with precision.
• Filter releases by market impact: High, Medium, and Low.
• Coverage across major currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, CAD, CHF, and NZD.
• Accurate local timezone sync: No confusing date overlaps.
• Instant Actual, Forecast, and Previous data with live countdowns.

AI Trade Verdict & Market Sentiment
Cut through financial jargon with algorithmic analysis.
• Instant AI trade verdicts providing directional bias (Bullish, Bearish, Neutral) and confidence scores.
• Macroeconomic impact breakdowns explaining why numbers matter for specific currency pairs.
• Actionable sentiment insights to plan high-probability entries.

24/7 Custom Price Alerts
Monitor key price levels for currency pairs, commodities, and crypto.
• Set custom breakout triggers (Crosses Above or Crosses Below target prices).
• Real-time monitoring for Gold (XAU/USD), Silver, EUR/USD, WTI Crude, Bitcoin, and more.
• Instant push notifications on your lock screen.

Live Currency Strength Index
Spot strong versus weak currencies at a single glance.
• Real-time relative momentum indicator covering all 8 major currencies.
• Clear visual heatmaps to identify strong trending pairs quickly.

Market Sessions & Overlap Map
Know exactly which global liquidity hubs are active.
• Visual 24-hour UTC session map tracking Tokyo, Sydney, London, and New York.
• Track session opens, closes, and major volume overlap periods in real time.

Professional Trade Journal
Master your risk management and trading discipline.
• Log trades with entry, exit, position size, leverage, stop loss, and take profit.
• Track your win rate, profit factor, best trade, and net profit/loss metrics.
• Review historical performance across Forex, Crypto, Indices, and Commodities.
